class.name: Itch
class.brief_description: High-level API for interacting with itch.io from Godot.
class.description:
Facade over the GodotItch GDExtension. Provides convenient methods to call itch.io endpoints and emits signals with parsed results. Requires calling [code]initialize_with_scene[/code] so the internal HTTPRequest can be added to the scene tree.
Authentication can come from either: - the itch launcher (environment variable [code]ITCHIO_API_KEY[/code]), or - an OAuth access token set via [code]Auth[/code] (see [code]start_oauth_authorization[/code]).
The extension automatically chooses the correct server path for your credential: - API key: [code]/api/1/key/...[/code] - JWT (OAuth): [code]/api/1/jwt/...[/code] In both cases, the token is sent in the [code]Authorization: Bearer <token>[/code] header.
Currently, with OAuth, only the [code]profile:me[/code] scope is supported by itch.io. As a result, the main supported endpoints are [code]get_credentials_info()[/code] and [code]get_me()[/code].

method.name: build_oauth_authorize_url
method.description: Returns the OAuth authorization URL built from the provided parameters.

method.name: get_auth
method.description: Returns the Auth instance that manages authentication.

method.name: get_core
method.description: Returns the Core instance providing low-level lifecycle and configuration.

method.name: get_credentials_info
method.description: Requests information about the current credentials. Calls [code]GET /api/1/{key|jwt}/credentials/info[/code] and emits [signal api_response] with endpoint [code]"credentials_info"[/code] on success. The response typically contains [code]scopes[/code] and, for JWT, an [code]expires_at[/code] field. On error, emits [signal api_error].

method.name: get_games
method.description: Returns the Games helper for game-related API operations.

method.name: get_godotitch_version
method.description: Returns the version string of the GodotItch extension.

method.name: get_me
method.description: Requests the current user's public profile data. Calls [code]GET /api/1/{key|jwt}/me[/code] (requires [code]profile:me[/code] scope) and emits [signal api_response] with endpoint [code]"get_me"[/code] on success. On error, emits [signal api_error].

method.name: get_oauth_client_id
method.description: Returns the OAuth client ID configured in the auth subsystem.

method.name: get_oauth_redirect_uri
method.description: Returns the OAuth redirect URI configured in the auth subsystem.

method.name: get_oauth_scope
method.description: Returns the OAuth scope string configured in the auth subsystem.

method.name: get_user
method.description: Returns the User helper exposing user-related data accessors.

method.name: has_api_key_present
method.description: Returns true if an API key is available from settings or the itch launcher.

method.name: initialize_with_scene
method.description: Initializes the extension and wires it to the provided scene node for processing and signal emission.

method.name: is_launched_via_itch
method.description: Returns true if the game was started via the itch.io app.

method.name: is_user_authenticated
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a bearer token is currently available (either OAuth token or launcher API key).

method.name: oauth_logged_out
method.description: Clears the current OAuth session and emits user_logged_out.

method.name: oauth_login_failed
method.description: Handles a failed OAuth login attempt with the provided error message. Emits user_login_failed.

method.name: oauth_login_success
method.description: Handles a successful OAuth login with the authenticated user payload. Emits user_logged_in.

method.name: post_request_check
method.description: Internal helper to process any pending HTTP requests or callbacks. Call within _process() if needed.

method.name: set_oauth_client_id
method.description: Sets the OAuth client ID in the auth subsystem.

method.name: set_oauth_redirect_uri
method.description: Sets the OAuth redirect URI in the auth subsystem.

method.name: set_oauth_scope
method.description: Sets the OAuth scope string in the auth subsystem.

method.name: start_oauth_authorization
method.description: Starts the OAuth authorization flow and opens the authorization URL for the user.

signal.name: api_error
signal.description: Emitted when an API call fails. Includes the endpoint path, error message, and HTTP status code.

signal.name: api_response
signal.description: Emitted when an API call succeeds. Provides the endpoint path and parsed response data.

signal.name: user_logged_in
signal.description: Emitted after a successful login with the authenticated user payload.

signal.name: user_logged_out
signal.description: Emitted when the current user logs out or the session is cleared.

signal.name: user_login_failed
signal.description: Emitted when a login attempt fails. Contains a human-readable error message.
